mapper.select: select template.*, business.topo_id, business.name, business.description, business.difficulty, business.logo, business.xd_template_type, business.xd_template_category from cr_team_template template join cr_business_template business on business.resource_id = template.business_template_id where business.business_type = 3 and business.xd_template_category = 1 and business.xd_template_type between 1 and 7 order by template.resource_id

select distinct task.room_id, task.user_id, mission.mission_template_id from cr_team_room room join cr_train_record record on record.room_id = room.resource_id join cr_task task on task.room_id = room.resource_id join cr_mission mission on mission.resource_id = task.mission_id and mission.room_id = room.resource_id join cr_role student on student.resource_id = task.role_id and student.room_id = room.resource_id join cr_score score on score.room_id = room.resource_id and score.user_id = task.user_id where room.team_template_id = #{templateId} and room.xd_type = #{type} and room.training_status = 2 and room.start_time >= #{start} and room.end_time < #{end} and record.business_type = 3 and record.user_id = #{teacherId} and record.start_time >= #{start} and record.end_time < #{end} and record.end_time > record.start_time and student.business_type = 3 and student.role_group = 2 and instr(student.user_ids, concat(concat('"', task.user_id), '"')) > 0 and score.final_score is not null and task.status in (1, 2) and exists (select 1 from cr_task_submit submitted where submitted.room_id = room.resource_id and submitted.task_id = task.resource_id and submitted.evaluate_status in (1, 2)) and exists (select 1 from cr_role teacher where teacher.room_id = room.resource_id and teacher.business_type = 3 and teacher.role_group = 1 and instr(teacher.user_ids, concat(concat('"', #{teacherId}), '"')) > 0)

select relation.course_id, max(relation.course_name) as course_name, relation.user_id from course_lesson_user_relation relation join cr_team_room room on room.resource_id = relation.lesson_id where room.team_template_id = #{templateId} group by relation.course_id, relation.user_id

choose.when: merge into cr_demo_data_run target using (select cast(#{businessDate,jdbcType=DATE} as date) as business_date from dual) source on (target.business_date = source.business_date) when matched then update set target.generated_count = target.generated_count when not matched then insert (business_date, generated_count, create_time) values (source.business_date, 0, current_timestamp)
choose.otherwise: insert into cr_demo_data_run (business_date, generated_count, create_time) values (#{businessDate}, 0, current_timestamp) on duplicate key update generated_count = generated_count

mapper.select: select generated_count from cr_demo_data_run where business_date = #{businessDate} for update
mapper.insert: insert into cr_demo_data_room (room_id, source_room_id, business_date, topo_digest) values (#{roomId}, #{sourceRoomId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{businessDate}, #{topoDigest})
